summary.name: 秘塔写作猫 (Dialogue Writing Cat / xiezuocat.com)
summary.one_liner: Xiezuocat (写作猫) is an interactive Chinese-English writing assistant from Shanghai-based Metasota (秘塔) that offers text error correction, rewriting/polishing, automatic continuation, and illustration generation.
use_cases: continuing a piece of writing automatically
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Xiezuocat (写作猫) as a new-generation interactive writing aid for Chinese and English, combining intelligent text error correction, rewriting and polishing, automatic continuation, and intelligent image generation for articles. It is operated by Shanghai Metasota Network Technology (上海秘塔网络科技有限公司), founded in 2018, which says it developed its own large language model MetaLLM and obtained generative AI model filings in 2023. The page also describes its data handling: TLS encryption for data in transit, 512-bit RSA encryption for stored user files, and access controls limiting users to their own files. The page itself is mostly a company profile and privacy/contact information; it does not detail pricing or feature specifics. The page shown is a browser-update notice, so the functional description is taken from the meta description and company text.
notable: Built on the company's own MetaLLM large language model, which the page says has passed generative model filing
Combines error correction, rewriting, auto-continuation and illustration generation in one tool
Describes TLS transport encryption and 512-bit RSA encrypted file storage
caveats: Page is a browser-update notice; feature details come mainly from the meta description and company text
Pricing and free-tier limits are not stated on the page
